def _tokenize(s):
    tokens=[]; i=0; n=len(s)
    while i<n:
        c=s[i]
        if c in ' \t': i+=1; continue
        # maybe if c.isspace(): i+=1; continue? choose.
        if c.isdigit():
            j=i
            while j<n and s[j].isdigit(): j+=1
            if j<n and s[j]=='.':
                j+=1
                while j<n and s[j].isdigit(): j+=1
            token_str=s[i:j]
            tokens.append(Token('NUM', _literal_value(token_str)))
            i=j
            continue
        if c=='.':
            # decimal literal starting with dot
            if i+1<n and s[i+1].isdigit():
                j=i+1
                while j<n and s[j].isdigit(): j+=1
                token_str=s[i:j]
                tokens.append(Token('NUM', _literal_value(token_str)))
                i=j
                continue
            raise ValueError("Invalid number")
        if c in '+-*/%()':
            if c=='*':
                if i+1<n and s[i+1]=='*': tokens.append(Token('OP','**')); i+=2
                else: tokens.append(Token('OP','*')); i+=1
            elif c=='/':
                if i+1<n and s[i+1]=='/': tokens.append(Token('OP','//')); i+=2
                else: tokens.append(Token('OP','/')); i+=1
            else:
                if c=='(': tokens.append(Token('LP','(')); i+=1
                elif c==')': tokens.append(Token('RP',')')); i+=1
                else: tokens.append(Token('OP',c)); i+=1
            continue
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid character {c!r}")
    return tokens
